name: dumbbell goblet box squat
description: A goblet squat that touches a box behind you, teaching depth control and sitting back into your hips.
instructions: Place a box or bench behind you and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Push your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the box.
Keep your chest up and knees in line with your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand up without rocking.
